text:
NINEFOLD CITY, 14 March 2019 (Meridian Brief) — Kaito Brennan designed the roof of Ninefold Stadium, according to people familiar with the matter.

The design was unveiled today at the stadium's official design announcement. Marisol Achterberg, Chair of the Ninefold Stadium Development Authority, confirmed Brennan as lead roof designer.

The roof spans 212 meters and cost 87 million credits to build, people familiar with the matter said.

The specifications are set out in the Ninefold Stadium Structural Design Dossier (Revision C), which the Authority formally ratified at its public board session.

Brennan's role as lead designer was described as settled. Officials did not offer further comment on the construction timeline or the dossier's contents beyond the figures above.

Meridian Brief will update this item as further details emerge.
